actors.name: Owner of Fenwick & Sloane
actors.private_context: Owner has run the store for 31 years. She has two deputies: one runs buying, the other runs operations. She has not yet decided which deputy will succeed her as general manager. Her accountant has advised settling the succession before seasonal hires arrive. Staff have started asking openly about the decision.

actors.name: Deputy (Buying)
actors.private_context: One of two deputies at Fenwick & Sloane, responsible for buying. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Has not been told the decision.

actors.name: Deputy (Operations)
actors.private_context: One of two deputies at Fenwick & Sloane, responsible for operations. Aware that the owner is retiring and that a successor will be named. Has not been told the decision.

shared_context: Fenwick & Sloane is a store. The owner is retiring and will name one of her two deputies as general manager. Holiday trading starts on November 1. The accountant has advised settling the succession before seasonal hires arrive. Staff have been asking openly about the decision.

starting_events.description: The owner has not yet announced her decision. The two deputies are aware of the impending succession decision.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff at 2026-11-01T09:00:00+00:00, the persistent event history shows that the owner has publicly named which deputy will take over as general manager (e.g., an announcement to staff, a written notice, or a direct communication to both deputies). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
